-- intro: Demon Ice Magic is a magic attribute that allows the user to generate and manipulate a sinister form of Ice Magic.
-- Description:
    This magic attribute allows the user to generate and manipulate a sinister form of ice at will. The frost is capable of freezing anything and everything, including shadows, light, and even invisible concepts. The user is able to use this magic without the need of a grimoire. Superior overall to its regular Ice Magic counterpart, this ice is extremely deadly and versatile, being able to freeze targets on impact, shooting a barrage of ice shards faster than the eye can see, releasing waves of freezing frost, unleashing a blizzard that freezes anything in its path, and a plethora of other phenomenally powerful ice techniques. Furthermore, the user can use this magic to turn their body, either partly or fully, into ice or even merge with and move through it.
